correctness.rationale: For finite H, complemented elements are its Boolean center. Splitting at central elements until each factor has trivial center yields H=product H_i, and the excluded-middle fraction is product 2/|H_i|. A non-Boolean trivial-center factor has size at least 3; if two existed the product is <=4/9, so equality 2/3 forces exactly one 3-element chain and only 2-element remaining factors. Conversely C3 x C2^k has ratio 2/3. Finite Birkhoff duality gives one 2-chain plus k isolates; k is unique from |H|. Direct reconstruction checked the factor argument and the package poset enumerator construction, not merely its logged outcome.
